verdict_reason: The corpus moves to valid commodityCode and Latin-name pairs from the stub, but it never sets the new commonName field, so the round-trip characterisation tests cannot catch it being lost.

todos.issue: This PR adds the commonName line obligation (lines.js, id c8824345) and commit-selection.js saves it on every line MDM gives a common name (the stub gives Bos taurus 'Cattle or Cow'), but no corpus line carries commonName. fulfilment-codec.test.js 'Should losslessly round-trip the $name evaluator map' and the golden-equivalence gates iterate this corpus, so dropping commonName in assembleFulfilments, the codec or from-fulfilment.js would leave every characterisation test green. The lines also do not match what reference data returns, which the ticket's stub AC asks for.
todos.fix: Must: at least one corpus line is a line the search page can save, including commonName, so the round-trip and golden tests fail if commonName is lost. One way: give commodityLine() a commonName default ('Cattle or Cow' for Bos taurus, the stub's value for Bison bison) and regenerate characterisation-oracles.json.
